capabilities: Crop, rotate, and flip images via a selection toolbar
Resize images with custom dimensions or predefined size classes
Apply CSS filters and one-click filter presets with a live histogram
Store edits as a portable Markdown attribute block beside the embed
Export the rendered edited image to a new file
disambiguation: Not a destructive image editor: edits are stored as an attribute block next to the embed and the original file is never modified; exporting writes a new copy.
extras: Includes a self-contained demo vault and an external documentation site; export uses the OS save dialog on desktop and falls back to an in-vault prompt on mobile; development is macOS-centric with less testing on other platforms.
problem: Obsidian only natively resizes embedded images; cropping, rotating, flipping, or filtering them requires external tools that modify the file.

relations.evidence: Editing Toolbar integration — optionally registers commands as buttons in Editing Toolbar

summary: Non-destructive image editor that crops, rotates, flips, resizes, and applies CSS filters to embedded images live, without modifying the original file.
